picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16, a major milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat and a concrete demonstration of AI moving from lab to real military hardware.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role in the DOE's Genesis Mission American Science Cloud represents a national-scale federated infrastructure effort to unify data, models, and HPC resources for AI-accelerated science, with broad implications across the national lab system.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health's launch of Converge with Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital creates a novel model embedding startups directly inside a live academic medical center, a structural innovation for how healthcare AI gets built and validated.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: The Frank Whittle Summit at Cambridge brought together UK government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven industrial strategy for aerospace, energy, and defence, signaling significant policy momentum behind hardware innovation.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge and UC Santa Barbara researchers constructed adversarial mathematical systems proving certain problems are fundamentally unlearnable by any AI regardless of data volume, a theoretical result that reshapes expectations about AI's limits.
picks.title: Testing the limits of what’s possible (and what isn’t) with AI

picks.editorial_note: A $2.7 million ARPA-E grant to Iowa State and Ames Lab funds AI-driven discovery of stronger magnets, pairing machine learning with advanced chemistry to accelerate materials science with real energy and manufacturing applications.
picks.title: AI-powered hunt for stronger magnets earns Iowa State and Ames Lab $2.7 million grant

picks.editorial_note: A major philanthropic gift is establishing Georgia Tech's Parker H. Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, a significant new institutional investment aimed at using AI to predict and treat disease.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University's MoU with NVIDIA and launch of the Chula AI Center marks a notable industry-academia partnership advancing AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Toyota Research Institute's SceneSmith uses multi-agent AI to automatically generate diverse 3D training environments for robots, addressing a key bottleneck in robotics: the scarcity of varied real-world training data.
picks.title: AI agents create virtual playgrounds to help robots get crucial training data

picks.editorial_note: A new Lawrence Livermore-UC Santa Barbara collaboration is applying AI to model extreme plasma physics relevant to nuclear fusion, connecting AI research directly to progress on a major energy science challenge.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
